correctness.rationale: For an unramified fixed-source triple of exact quadratic maps to (P1)^3, the differential has sections R_i of O(2) and the exact sequence 0→O(2)→O(4)^3→N→0. Rank two and degree ten, together with global generation of N(-4), restrict splitting to (5,5) or (4,6); Serre duality identifies h0(N(-6)) with 3-rank(R_1,R_2,R_3). The no-common-zero condition excludes rank one. For odd/zero characteristic, the basepoint-free pencil-to-ramification map is a smooth PGL2 torsor onto the open in P2, and pulling back the rank-two 3x3 determinant hypersurface excludes its singular rank-one locus; irreducibility is inherited from collinear-point incidence. The determinant has multidegree (2,2,2). In characteristic two the mixed coefficient vanishes and rank is universally 2 on U. Independently checked symbolic Wronskian, explicit balanced/jumping examples and characteristic-two witness; finite tests confirm, not prove, universal results.
